description: App-side canon-2 review chain vector (actor_app_role). Records 1-2 are canon 1 (no canon_version: hash over CHAIN_FIELDS only, as in the DA fixtures); records 3-5 are canon 2: hash over CHAIN_FIELDS + actor_app_role + canon_version (int). Signer: deterministic test HMAC stand-in sha256('canon2-vec|' + record_hash), alg HS256-canon2-vector, key k-canon2-vector.
